quotes.text: "The outgoing hostname error message should be hidden"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: After editing the outgoing hostname, this task checks isHidden on incomingConfigTemplate/#incomingHostnameErrorMessage, but its message says the outgoing error should be hidden. The mismatch is inherited and remains in the accepted source; it is not introduced by the wait changes. This assertion cannot prove the named outgoing error is hidden. No failing runtime was reproduced.
title: The manual-config outgoing-error assertion reads the incoming target
